project_type: Next.js 16 App Router + Supabase (Auth, Database, Storage)
build_system: Next.js with npm, deployable on Vercel
test_framework: None - uses npm run build for validation
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to ensure TypeScript compiles and Next.js builds successfully
setup_instructions: npm install, copy .env.local.example to .env.local, configure Supabase credentials, npm run dev
environment_constraints: Open internet available. Supabase project not connected - app is ready to connect with env vars.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project - no existing contribution guidelines
key_patterns: Next.js App Router with Server/Client components, Supabase SSR pattern, type aliases for Database types, Tailwind CSS v4 with @theme in globals.css
directory_structure: src/app/ for routes and pages, src/lib/ for utilities (Supabase clients), src/components/ for shared UI components, src/hooks/ for React hooks, src/types/ for TypeScript types, supabase/ for migrations and seed SQL
